scope: Observed GFX100RF 11664x8750 RGGB active lattice into observed X2D 100C donor layout

invariants.name: sub_black_and_per_cfa_black
invariants.expected: every source code at or below its CFA black level maps to target black without unsigned wrap

invariants.name: white_endpoint
invariants.expected: each CFA source white endpoint maps exactly to target white without overflow

invariants.name: monotonic_ramp
invariants.expected: mapped codes are monotonic and preserve exact black/white endpoints

invariants.name: one_to_one_geometry
invariants.expected: complete active lattice maps 1:1 with RGGB phase and donor margins unchanged

claim_boundary: Passes deterministic software/range invariants and seven natural-scene regressions; does not substitute synthetic tests for sensor dark/flat/chart characterization.
